title: Monumenta
description: The "Complete the Monument" MMO - a massive co-operative Survival-mode adventure!
body:
### Welcome to Monumenta, the "Complete the Monument" MMO!
You stand on the threshold of a truly unique adventure born from the "Complete the Monument" genre of adventure maps.
**Monumenta is a full-featured MMORPG, centered around Survival-mode PVE adventures through massive handmade dungeons.** 
Active and updated weekly since mid-2017, Monumenta now contains hundreds of hours of quality enjoyment through three huge worlds, hundreds of points of interest and dozens of quests. 
Explore and conquer solo or cooperatively with friends using 8 highly customizable classes and thousands of unique items.
_Monumenta remains a completely free, volunteer-made labor of love. We hope you enjoy your time here!_
